record.testFailureExplanation: Execution completed; some cases did not pass. Review the unsuccessful cases for details.
record.unknownFailure: The run ended abnormally; the cause is not yet confirmed. Recorded case results remain available. Review execution issues and technical details before retrying.
record.case.PASSED: This case passed the checks executed in this run.
record.case.FAILED: This case did not pass. Review the recorded reason and evidence.
record.case.SKIPPED: This case was skipped; it provides no pass or fail conclusion.
record.case.ABORTED: This case was aborted, not passed; its checks may be incomplete.
record.reason.WORKER_EXECUTION_FAILED: The Worker reported an unsuccessful outcome. The cause is pending confirmation; this code alone does not establish a service or driver fault. Review case results, execution issues and report validation before retrying.
record.reason.TEST_FAILURE: Some cases did not pass. Check the report and cleanup evidence, then review the case details; execution completeness has not yet been confirmed.
record.reason.REPORT_INCONSISTENT: The report did not match persisted execution evidence. Its overall conclusion is unverified; retain the results and inspect report processing before retrying.
record.reason.RUN_TIMEOUT: The execution budget was exceeded. Some cases may be incomplete; inspect recorded results and cleanup evidence before retrying.
record.reason.WORKER_EXITED_UNEXPECTEDLY: The Worker exited without a valid final event. Results may be incomplete; inspect Worker logs and cleanup evidence before retrying.
record.reason.WORKER_PROTOCOL_ERROR: The Worker event stream was invalid. The overall result is unverified; check Server/Worker versions and the recorded evidence.
record.reason.WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: The Worker could not be started. Check its executable and server configuration, then retry.
record.reason.CLEANUP_FAILURE: Cleanup did not complete. Review retained objects and ownership evidence before running more tests.
record.reason.INTERRUPTED: Execution was interrupted. Inspect completed cases and cleanup evidence before retrying.
record.reason.REPORT_NOT_FOUND: The report is unavailable. Recorded results remain available; inspect report generation and storage.
errors.TEST_FAILURE: Some cases did not pass. Check the report and cleanup evidence, then review the case details; execution completeness has not yet been confirmed.
record.reason.PREPARATION_FAILED: Test preparation failed. Cases may not have started; review the recorded preparation issue and cleanup evidence before retrying.
record.reason.WORKER_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: Server and Worker protocol versions do not match. Execution could not start; use matching build artifacts and retry.
record.reason.SERVER_SHUTDOWN: The service stopped during execution. Results may be incomplete; inspect recorded cases and cleanup evidence before retrying.
record.legacyExplanation: The report and cleanup completed with unsuccessful cases. The older version recorded case failures as a task error; available evidence shows no independent execution issue.
record.legacyExitEvidence: The historical exit code, final event and Worker artifact fingerprint were not retained, so process behavior after report generation cannot be verified. The original status is preserved.
record.nameRequired: Enter a task name (up to 200 characters)
record.reason.PREFLIGHT_FAILURE: Preflight checks failed; some cases did not run. Review the recorded cause and target configuration before retrying.
record.reason.CONTAINER_FAILURE: An execution error occurred; some checks may be incomplete. Review execution issues and cleanup before retrying.
record.reason.INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION: Some cases did not finish, so the overall result is incomplete. Review aborted and unexecuted cases and execution diagnostics.
record.reason.NO_TESTS_EXECUTED: No cases actually ran, so no compatibility conclusion is available. Review skip reasons and execution configuration.
